market_source: ESPN closing lines matched by team and tip time (internal QA only, not displayed)
method: 14-day expanding-window walk-forward: every graded game is predicted by models fit only on games from earlier local dates; Elo/rest/ratings are pregame by construction.

nba_calibration.target: slope CI includes 1, intercept CI includes 0, p>=0.8 bucket |mean p - hit| <= 0.04

wnba_pooled_brier.target: <= 0.2085 (n < 500 per season: judge on the paired CI vs market)
wnba_pooled_brier.subset: 2025 regular season after its 60th game + 2026 regular season

wnba_2026.target: accuracy >= 0.70 and log_loss <= 0.56 (n=330 < 500: judge on the paired CI vs market)

wnba_calibration.target: slope CI includes 1, intercept CI includes 0, p>=0.8 bucket |mean p - hit| <= 0.04
